title.en: Swap tokens on Uniswap, with a signed Permit2 allowance
title.zh-TW: 用 Uniswap 兌換代幣，附上簽好的 Permit2 授權

summary.en: The Safe calls `execute` on Uniswap's Universal Router. It first uses `PERMIT2_PERMIT` to hand over a Permit2 allowance the Safe's signers signed beforehand (to the router, 2^160-1, 30 days), then runs `V4_SWAP`: in one v4 pool with no hook, it sells the amount you type, and all of the bought token goes to the Safe. The router's allowance in Permit2 stays after the transaction.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 呼叫 Uniswap Universal Router 的 `execute`，先用 `PERMIT2_PERMIT` 交出 Safe 簽署人事先簽好的 Permit2 授權（給 router，2^160-1，30 天），再 `V4_SWAP`：在一個沒有 hook 的 v4 池子，把你填的數量賣掉，買進的代幣全部給 Safe。Permit2 裡給 router 的授權交易後留著。

text.en: The template binds the swap itself. But the Permit2 allowance is a message signed separately beforehand, and kiss-sign does not check that step.
text.zh-TW: 兌換本身有綁住；但 Permit2 授權是事先另外簽的訊息，kiss-sign 不檢查那一步。

pastTxsConclusion.en: No Safe swap was found. 141 of the 240 transactions studied called router 0x66a9893cC07D91D95644AEDD05D03f95e1dBA8Af, not this one; the 6 to this router add commands or encode the swap otherwise.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 沒找到 Safe 的兌換。研究的 240 筆裡有 141 筆呼叫 router 0x66a9893cC07D91D95644AEDD05D03f95e1dBA8Af，不是這個；送到這個 router 的 6 筆多了指令或編碼不同。

intro.en: Uniswap: the largest decentralized exchange on Ethereum. All v4 pools live in one PoolManager contract.
intro.zh-TW: Uniswap：以太坊上最大的去中心化交易所；v4 的池子都在同一個 PoolManager 合約裡。

text.en: The v4 core and periphery contracts and the Universal Router all have public audit reports (OpenZeppelin, Spearbit, Certora and others), in each repo's audits folder.
text.zh-TW: v4 核心與周邊合約、Universal Router 都有公開的審計報告（OpenZeppelin、Spearbit、Certora 等），放在各 repo 的 audits 資料夾。

text.en: The Permit2 allowance this transaction uses is a Safe message (EIP-1271) that the Safe's signers signed beforehand, and kiss-sign does not check that step. The template binds the allowance's contents in the transaction, so a wrongly signed one makes the transaction fail. But an allowance you were tricked into signing for someone else can be used without this transaction.
text.zh-TW: 這筆交易用的 Permit2 授權是 Safe 簽署人事先簽的 Safe 訊息（EIP-1271），kiss-sign 不檢查那一步。交易裡的授權內容模板有綁住，簽錯會讓交易失敗；但被騙簽給別人的授權，不需要這筆交易就能被用掉。

recommendation.en: When you sign the Permit2 message, check that the spender is Universal Router 0x23617e59A5925b2A4Bf75d73ff6711cD0b29De85.
recommendation.zh-TW: 簽 Permit2 訊息時確認 spender 是 Universal Router 0x23617e59A5925b2A4Bf75d73ff6711cD0b29De85。

text.en: You type the card's "minimum to receive" yourself. The Uniswap app's trading API works out the slippage at each quote (auto slippage 0.5% to 5.5%), and the price comes from a route the API finds across many pools, which no view on chain can read.
text.zh-TW: 卡片的「最少收到的數量」要你自己填：Uniswap app 的滑價由它的交易 API 每次報價時算（自動滑價 0.5% 到 5.5%），價格來自 API 在很多池子間找的路由，鏈上沒有一個 view 讀得到。

recommendation.en: Type the minimum to receive shown on the app's confirm screen. Do not type a lower one.
recommendation.zh-TW: 照 app 確認畫面上的最少收到數量填，不要填得更低。

text.en: The app picks the pool (fee and tick spacing). The template allows any pool and only requires that it has no hook. Anyone can open a v4 pool, so the only price protection is the minimum you type: below it, the router makes the transaction fail, and verify also gives MISMATCH.
text.zh-TW: 池子（手續費和 tick 間距）由 app 選，模板不限，只要求沒有 hook。任何人都能開 v4 池子，所以價格只靠你填的最少數量保護：少於它，router 讓交易失敗，verify 也會 MISMATCH。

recommendation.en: Acceptable. Always type the minimum to receive that the app shows.
recommendation.zh-TW: 可以接受；最少收到的數量一定照 app 顯示的填。

text.en: Allowances that stay after the transaction: the Safe's unlimited allowance to Permit2, and the 2^160-1, 30-day allowance to the Universal Router inside Permit2. The router pulls tokens only from the address that calls it, so only the Safe's own later transactions can use it.
text.zh-TW: 交易後留著的授權：Safe 給 Permit2 的無上限授權，和 Permit2 裡給 Universal Router 的 2^160-1、30 天授權。router 只從呼叫它的地址拉代幣，所以只有 Safe 自己之後的交易能用它。

recommendation.en: Acceptable. To revoke, call approve(Permit2, 0) on the token, or call lockdown on Permit2.
recommendation.zh-TW: 可以接受；想收回時，對代幣呼叫 approve(Permit2, 0)，或在 Permit2 呼叫 lockdown。

text.zh-TW: Etherscan 地址頁列出的創建交易

1.execute.commands.en: The list of commands, one command per byte. 0x0a is `PERMIT2_PERMIT` (use a signed Permit2 allowance), 0x10 is `V4_SWAP` (one v4 swap).
1.execute.commands.zh-TW: 指令清單，每個 byte 一個指令。0x0a 是 `PERMIT2_PERMIT`（用簽好的 Permit2 授權），0x10 是 `V4_SWAP`（一次 v4 兌換）。

1.execute.inputs.en: One set of parameters per command, in the same order as the command list.
1.execute.inputs.zh-TW: 每個指令一份參數，順序和指令清單一樣。

1.execute.inputs[1].en: The parameters of `V4_SWAP`: the list of v4 actions and each action's parameters.
1.execute.inputs[1].zh-TW: `V4_SWAP` 的參數：v4 動作清單和每個動作的參數。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.actions.en: The list of v4 actions: 0x07 `SWAP_EXACT_IN` (swap by the input amount), 0x0b `SETTLE` (pay the token sold), 0x0e `TAKE` (take the token bought).
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.actions.zh-TW: v4 動作清單：0x07 `SWAP_EXACT_IN`（照輸入數量兌換）、0x0b `SETTLE`（付出賣的代幣）、0x0e `TAKE`（領走買到的代幣）。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params.en: One set of parameters for each of the three actions.

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: What the swap does: what to sell, which pool it goes through, how much to sell, and the least to get.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 兌換的內容：賣什麼、經過哪個池子、賣多少、最少要拿到多少。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The pools it goes through, one item per pool. The template accepts only one pool.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 經過的池子，一個池子一項；模板只接受一個池子。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: That pool: the token on the other side, the fee, the tick spacing, the hook.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 那個池子：另一邊的代幣、手續費、tick 間距、hook。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The token this hop swaps into, that is, the token bought.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 這一跳換到的代幣，也就是買進的代幣。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The pool's fee tier, set when the app picks the route. Between USDC and USDT, 7 and 8 have been seen (7 and 8 per million). Another value means another pool, or a pool that does not exist.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 池子的手續費等級，app 選路由時決定；USDC 和 USDT 之間看過 7 和 8（百萬分之 7、8）。換成別的值就是別的池子或不存在的池子。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The pool's tick spacing. Together with the fee, it decides which pool this is. Every one seen was 1.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 池子的 tick 間距，和手續費一起決定是哪個池子；看過的都是 1。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The pool's hook contract. The zero address means no hook, so no extra contract runs during the swap.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 池子的 hook 合約；零地址代表沒有 hook，兌換時不會跑任何額外的合約。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: Data for the hook. There is no hook, so it is empty.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 給 hook 的資料；沒有 hook，所以是空的。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The lowest price for each hop, optional. It can only make the transaction fail when the price is too poor. It was empty in every transaction seen.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 每一跳的最低價格，可有可無；只會讓價格太差時交易失敗。看過的交易都是空的。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The amount to sell, in the token's base units.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 賣出的數量，以代幣的最小單位計。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.en: The least amount of the bought token to get. Below this, the router makes the whole transaction fail.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[0].SW.zh-TW: 最少要拿到的買進代幣數量；少於這個數，router 讓整筆交易失敗。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[1].SE.en: The token to pay to the pool, that is, the token sold.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[1].SE.zh-TW: 要付給池子的代幣，也就是賣出的代幣。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[1].SE.en: 0 means pay the full amount the swap owes, that is, `amountIn`.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[1].SE.zh-TW: 0 代表付清兌換欠下的全部數量，也就是 `amountIn`。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[1].SE.en: true means the Safe that calls the router pays; the router pulls the token from the Safe through Permit2.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[1].SE.zh-TW: true 代表由呼叫 router 的 Safe 付款，router 透過 Permit2 從 Safe 拉代幣。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.en: The token to take, that is, the token bought.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.zh-TW: 要領走的代幣，也就是買進的代幣。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.en: Who receives the bought token. It must be the Safe itself.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.zh-TW: 誰收到買進的代幣；必須是 Safe 自己。

1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.en: 0 means take the full amount the swap gives.
1.execute.inputs[1].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.zh-TW: 0 代表領走兌換得到的全部數量。

1.execute.deadline.en: After this time the router refuses the swap. The app sets it when it builds the transaction; in the transactions seen it was about 30 minutes ahead.
1.execute.deadline.zh-TW: 過了這個時間 router 就拒絕這筆兌換；app 建交易時設定，看過的交易大約是 30 分鐘後。

1.execute.inputs[0].en: The parameters of `PERMIT2_PERMIT`: the Permit2 allowance the Safe's signers signed beforehand, and that signature.
1.execute.inputs[0].zh-TW: `PERMIT2_PERMIT` 的參數：Safe 的簽署人事先簽好的 Permit2 授權，和那份簽名。

1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.en: The contents of the signed allowance.
The allowance's token, amount, expiry and nonce.
1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.zh-TW: 授權的代幣、數量、到期時間和 nonce。

1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.en: The token the allowance is for, that is, the token sold.
1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.zh-TW: 授權的代幣，也就是賣出的代幣。

1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.en: The allowance amount, 2^160-1, Permit2's unlimited; the Uniswap app's default.
1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.zh-TW: 授權數量 2^160-1，Permit2 的無上限；Uniswap app 的預設。

1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.en: When the allowance expires. The app sets it 30 days ahead; the verify page shows it.
1.execute.inputs[0].PERMIT2_PERMIT.permi.zh-TW: 授權到期時間，app 設 30 天後；verify 的網頁會顯示。
